WITH scan_site_join AS (
  SELECT
    scans.gbsize,
    scans.spanmin,
    sites.zoneregistry,
    sites.healtheval
  FROM scans
  INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
),
rates_with_status AS (
  SELECT
    zoneregistry,
    healtheval,
    gbsize / spanmin AS rate
  FROM scan_site_join
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin > 0
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT
    healtheval,
    AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zoneregistry) AS distinct_sites
  FROM rates_with_status
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_rate
  FROM status_stats
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT
    ss.avg_rate,
    ss.distinct_sites,
    oa.overall_rate
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_rate oa
  WHERE ss.avg_rate > oa.overall_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate,
  AVG(distinct_sites) AS avg_distinct_sites,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_rate) AS avg_excess_rate
FROM filtered_statuses

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing values" for rate calculation excludes rows where gbsize or spanmin is NULL, or spanmin is 0 (to avoid division by zero).
"The number of distinct sites scanned" counts distinct sites within each health/safety status group (sites that had scans with that status value).
